title: 「重要な日米同盟見てもらえ光栄」米海軍F35Cステルス戦闘機、海自救難飛行艇US2も
extracted_text: 米軍と海上自衛隊が共用する山口県岩国市の岩国航空基地で3日、基地を一般開放する「フレンドシップデー」が開催され、米海軍のF35Cステルス戦闘機やFA18F戦闘攻撃機が展示飛行を実施。海上自衛隊の救難飛行艇US2のフライトも行われた。 地上展示では航空自衛隊の最新鋭ステルス戦闘機F35Bや米海軍のCMV22オスプレイなどが並び、来場者から注目を浴びていた。 広島県三原市から家族3人で訪れた40代の男性は「国際情勢もあって参加するか少し迷いました。平和になってより楽しめれば」。山口県下関市から家族3人で訪れた30代の男性は「迫力ある展示を見ることができてよかった。日米で協力する国防の頼もしさを感じました」と話していた。 緊張の続く中東情勢を受けて、岩国航空基地司令のケネス・ロスマン大佐は「重要な日米の同盟関係をみなさまに見ていただくことができて、大変光栄だ」と話した。（写真報道局　彦野公太朗）
translated_text: On the 3rd, a "Friendship Day" was held at Iwakuni Air Base in Iwakuni City, Yamaguchi Prefecture, which is shared by the US military and the Japan Maritime Self-Defense Force, opening the base to the public. The US Navy's F35C stealth fighter and FA18F fighter attack aircraft conducted display flights. The Japan Maritime Self-Defense Force's US-2 rescue flying boat also flew. The ground display featured the Japan Air Self-Defense Force's cutting-edge F35B stealth fighter and the US Navy's CMV-22 Osprey, drawing attention from visitors. A man in his 40s who visited with his family of three from Mihara City, Hiroshima Prefecture, said, "I was a bit unsure about attending given the international situation, but it would be nice if things were more peaceful and we could enjoy it more." A man in his 30s who visited with his family of three from Shimonoseki City, Yamaguchi Prefecture, said, "It was great to see such impressive displays. I felt the reliability of national defense cooperation between Japan and the US." In response to the continuing tense Middle East situation, Base Commander Colonel Kenneth Rothman said, "It is a great honor to be able to show everyone the important Japan-US alliance relationship." (Photo Press Bureau, Koutaro Hikono)
title_en: "It's an Honor to Show the Important Japan-US Alliance" - US Navy F35C Stealth Fighters, Japan MSDF US-2 Rescue Aircraft Also on Display
